related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment environmental-capability projection and append-only observation correction mechanism

request.operation: trace why the recorded recommendation correction was rejected and whether bounded projection compaction preserves that diagnostic

outcome.compaction_gap: The evidence-priority fallback retains one linked occurrence-to-pressure-to-improvement path and replaces the full observation list. A rejected correction outside that path therefore loses its diagnostic unless the compactor preserves a bounded summary separately.
outcome.evidence_basis: The gap was identified in the response-compaction implementation against an authentic rejected correction in the campaign ledger. This is a projection visibility limitation; the inspection did not establish that an agent was blocked or quantify intervention burden.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The recorded rejection applies to the selected evidence pages and does not establish that matching evidence is absent from other pages or campaigns.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Budgeted ECI responses omit why an append-only recommendation correction was rejected
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment environmental-capability projection and correction validation
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Retain a bounded, provenance-linked correction rejection summary alongside the priority evidence path.

not_measured: Whether an agent needed extra investigation because the correction reason was omitted before this change.
Whether the same visibility gap recurs across independent sessions or other correction fields.
Whether the new summary reduces agent intervention burden.
Whether a matching occurrence exists outside the selected evidence pages.
